text:
Asking rents in Essen stand at a median of 9.70 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.2% on the year and +26.1% over five years. That ranks Essen #29 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 44% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.72 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 582 € a month in cold rent, 13.5% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 32 days and 21% are gone within a week; with 2.6% market-active vacancy and +0.4% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.24 €/m² (+5.5%), with an 80% range of 9.97 to 10.38 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
